name: Hotkey Hints
author: justarieldotcom
description: Hold Super, Alt, Ctrl, or Shift to see which hotkeys branch off it — then add more modifiers to drill in. Closes the moment you let go.

barWidget.description: Settings for the hold-a-modifier hotkey overlay (the overlay itself has no bar popup — it only appears while a modifier is held).

schema.label: Font family
schema.description: Leave empty to use the bar's own theme font.

schema.label: Direct combos shown per level
schema.description: How many completed hotkeys are listed at once. Keep low so the overlay never covers more than a sliver of the screen; extras collapse into a '+N more' chip.

schema.label: Remember most-used hotkeys
schema.description: Sort each level's hotkey chips by how often you actually press them, most-used first. Only real, currently-bound combos you press are ever counted (never ordinary typing or app shortcuts); counts are stored locally in ~/.local/state/omarchy/hotkey-hints-usage.json. Turning this off keeps the counts but stops using them; use Reset to clear them.
